state:
- Novelty rests mainly on salvage-based selection, since DHODH-driven differentiation follows directly from S4. Check prior teriflunomide/leflunomide AML studies and identify the genuinely new context-specific prediction.
- “Salvage-low” and the proposed therapeutic window lack operational thresholds. Prespecify the tracer-based classification, verified unbound-exposure ceiling, and minimum leukemia-versus-normal functional separation.
- Uridine rescue tests pyrimidine dependence but does not establish that baseline salvage causes selective sensitivity. Add bidirectional salvage-pathway perturbations and test whether they shift differentiation responses independently of proliferation.
